tools.name: browse_latest
tools.description: Return the 20 most recently published Design Fragments items as a compact list (item_id, title, description, url, tags, category, hasNotes). Use this to browse what is new on the site. Does not open an item; call open_item with an item_id for full detail and notes.

tools.name: browse_month
tools.description: List every Design Fragments item published in a given calendar month. The public archive currently runs from 2021-07 through 2026-08. Use when the visitor asks what was published in a specific year and month. Returns a compact list (item_id, title, description, url, tags, category, hasNotes). Call open_item for full detail.

tools.name: browse_tag
tools.description: List items for one tag (slug or Chinese/English label). Use after list_tags or when an item result includes that tag. Returns a compact list (item_id, title, description, url, tags, category, hasNotes) and opens /tag/{slug}.

tag.description: Tag slug or label, e.g. typography or 排版

tools.name: get_similar
tools.description: Find items similar to a given item_id. Use only when the visitor asks for related or similar fragments after viewing an item. Returns a compact list (item_id, title, description, url, tags, category, hasNotes). Does not open an item.

item_id.description: Item id to find similar fragments for

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every public tag on Design Fragments, with label, slug, and /tag/... path. Use when the visitor wants to browse by tag or pick from available tags. Does not list themes; if open_item notes include a theme, open its /theme/{slug} path in the browser. Call browse_tag with a slug or label to see items.

tools.name: open_item
tools.description: Open one Design Fragments item by item_id and return its full detail, including notes (published knowledge atoms with entity, summary, types, and theme pages) when the item has them. Each theme includes a /theme/{slug} path — open that URL in the browser to view the theme. There is no theme catalog tool. Use after browse_latest, browse_month, search_items, or a tag result. Does not include similar items; call get_similar for those. Also navigates the page to /item?id= so the visitor can see the same item.

item_id.description: Public item id from a previous list result

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Keyword-search published Design Fragments items and return a compact result list (item_id, title, description, url, tags, category, hasNotes). Use for finding fragments by title, description, tags, domain, or URL text. This is exact/keyword search only — not semantic search. Does not return knowledge, snippets, or domain tabs. Call open_item for full detail.

query.description: Keyword query to search published items
